properties.name: font
properties.comment: The font OK or Apply last took (initially 9-unit Carlito, like Windows Forms' default); not the dialog's own text font (G1). A view, since OK and Apply move it. A write also resets the selection to it and marks the font as set from code; an invalid FontSpec throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: a view onto font_, which OK, Apply and close move; write_view resets the selection to it, even when unchanged

properties.name: show_apply
properties.comment: Whether the Apply button is shown.
hand: written shows or hides the Apply button

properties.name: preview_text
properties.comment: The preview text; invalid UTF-8 throws std::invalid_argument.
prepare: if (!validate_utf8(incoming).valid()) throw std::invalid_argument("FontDialog preview text must be valid UTF-8");

not_properties.name: set_size_range
not_properties.reason: two values that clamp the selection together; kept as a method

not_properties.name: surface
not_properties.reason: read at the next show(); a plain presentation choice, not a property of the dialog's content
